name: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
description: Validates foundational cybersecurity skills assessing the security posture of an enterprise environment and recommending security solutions. 90 minutes.

domains.name: General Security Concepts
domains.description: Domain 1 (12%): Compare security controls, apply authentication/authorization, understand PKI and cryptography.

domains.name: Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations
domains.description: Domain 2 (22%): Threat actors, attack vectors, vulnerabilities, and mitigation techniques.

domains.name: Security Architecture
domains.description: Domain 3 (18%): Security models, cloud infrastructure security, resilience and recovery.

domains.name: Security Operations
domains.description: Domain 4 (28%): Applying security baselines, monitoring, vulnerability scanning, and incident response.

domains.name: Security Program Management and Oversight
domains.description: Domain 5 (20%): Governance, compliance, risk management, and security awareness.
